scope: Continue standalone prompt iteration on unresolved independent persona generation. Keep the 18 confirmed action/extraction prompts frozen. No production prompt changes, repository commits or full notebook reruns.
acceptance: All original demographic, household, financial, political, reading and exact-name constraints explicitly retained.
All 17 mandatory fields and all five stated-scale personality values present; complete response, no refusal.
Coherent biography, chronology, finances and travel; no unsupported external event-calendar premise.
Within each source, differences extend beyond city names and job titles to desired experiences, routines or social commitments.
No prescribed survey answer, spending direction, personality score spread, occupation quota or rejection of coherent preferences merely because they repeat.
A candidate with substantial diversity or coherence failures is not selected by retaining only its best responses.
reassessment: Review all six responses before further paid work. If the known archetype collapse persists, do not repeat small wording changes indefinitely. Consider a clearly labeled change in generation procedure, or report a prompt-only limitation.
limitations: Small selected diagnostic sample, assistant qualitative review, not blinded human ratings.
Observed variation is not a calibrated population distribution or proof of absent demographic stereotypes.
No fixed-prompt method can guarantee a distribution when no target distribution was supplied.
